sar.narrative: This report details an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, internally documented as case AC-HHF-003. It involves customer C11663, using debit Mastercard C11663-K1, and is connected to five other cards: C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C09026-K1, and C09148-K1. The activity began on 2017-01-22 at 12:55 with an online transaction, 3660147, for $181.73 in region 327.0. This was followed by transaction 3660148 for $357.82 on 2017-01-23 at 07:25 in region 327.0, and transaction 3660149 for $811.92 on 2017-01-24 at 19:13 in region 327.0. The amounts then escalated to $1,800.00 with transactions 3660150 on 2017-01-26 at 19:51 in region 327.0, 3660151 on 2017-01-27 at 19:12 in region 327.0, 3660152 on 2017-01-28 at 17:31 in region 327.0, and 3660153 on 2017-01-31 at 17:31 in region 315.0. All these online purchases were for product code C and lacked identity records. This pattern on C11663-K1, which resumed after at least 21 days of inactivity, matches a similar escalating online drain with no identity records found on the 5 peer cards. The flagged transaction 3660153 for $1,800.00 significantly exceeds the card's prior median transaction amount of $91.98 and matches its prior maximum amount of $1,800.00, while the rapid sequence and escalation of online charges are inconsistent with the card's baseline of 57 prior transactions. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. An internal case AC-HHF-003 was opened on 2017-01-31, connected cards are being monitored, and the matter has been escalated to an analyst. A block of card C11663-K1 is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval. This suspicious activity report, covering a total exposure of $8,551.47, is also recommended and awaiting fraud-manager approval.
